resources.string: The Jarvis gateway serves the chat page and is also its WebSocket endpoint. Enter its https:// base URL — the page derives its own wss:// address from it.
Keep the session alive in the background
Runs an ongoing notification so the WebSocket and microphone survive when Jarvis is not in the foreground.
Enter an http:// or https:// URL.
Shown while the Jarvis connection is kept alive in the background.
Notifications raised by the Jarvis web app through the native bridge.
Connection and microphone session kept alive.
Microphone permission is required for voice.
